root_cause.text: The Qualcomm QUSB2 PHY probe path enabled runtime PM before storing the `qphy` object in `dev` driver data, creating a race where `qusb2_phy_runtime_suspend()` could run with `dev_get_drvdata(dev) == NULL` and dereference it during early suspend.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `dev_set_drvdata(dev, qphy);` before PM setup, changes `pm_runtime_enable(dev)` to `devm_pm_runtime_enable(dev)`, and reorders `pm_runtime_set_active(dev); pm_runtime_forbid(dev);` specifically because “Enabling runtime PM before attaching the QPHY instance as driver data can lead to a NULL pointer dereference in runtime PM callbacks” and there was “a small window where the suspend callback may run after PM runtime enabling and before runtime forbid.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Convert qusb2 PHY probe to devm-managed runtime PM and keep runtime PM forbidden by default, removing manual cleanup on failure.
intent_record.what: In `qusb2_phy_probe()`, `dev_set_drvdata(dev, qphy)` was moved earlier in the function, the runtime PM setup was changed from `pm_runtime_enable(dev)` to `devm_pm_runtime_enable(dev)`, the comment was updated to describe enabling runtime PM support while forbidding it by default, `pm_runtime_forbid(dev)` was added after `pm_runtime_set_active(dev)`, and the explicit `pm_runtime_disable(dev)` cleanup calls were removed from the error paths.
intent_record.how: The driver now registers its private data sooner and uses devm-managed runtime PM enablement so PM state is automatically cleaned up on probe failure or device removal. Runtime PM remains available but starts in a forbidden state, preventing automatic power management until userspace explicitly allows it via sysfs, while avoiding manual disable handling on errors.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly affects the qusb2 PHY probe/runtime PM sequence involved in the race. Converting to devm-managed runtime PM and keeping runtime PM forbidden by default is a fix in the same area as the bug where PM was enabled before driver data was stored, preventing early suspend from seeing a NULL drvdata.

candidates.rationale: This enables runtime PM before the driver data pointer is stored with dev_set_drvdata(dev, qphy);, allowing an early runtime suspend callback to run and dereference a NULL dev_get_drvdata(dev).

bic_trace_step.reason: The probe path in this diff enables runtime PM before the driver data assignment is visible to runtime callbacks: `pm_runtime_set_active(dev); pm_runtime_enable(dev); pm_runtime_forbid(dev);` appears in `qusb2_phy_probe()` before `qphy->phy = generic_phy;` and before any explicit `dev_set_drvdata()` in the shown snippet. The runtime suspend callback dereferences `dev_get_drvdata(dev)` immediately: `struct qusb2_phy *qphy = dev_get_drvdata(dev);` followed by `const struct qusb2_phy_cfg *cfg = qphy->cfg;`, so a suspend occurring during probe could see NULL drvdata and crash. There is no fix present in this snippet because the ordering issue is not addressed here; the code still enables runtime PM before the object is guaranteed to be stored as driver data.
